rows.description: Open your mind to vaste experiences of your ancestors. Gain +5 insight bonus to Intelligence-based skill checks. (70+CASTERLEVEL)%% chance of obtaining specific ancestral memory [GM discretion] to assist in overcoming problem.

Anytime a harmless spell of 3rd level or lower is cast within the area of effect, you may choose to immediately gain the benefit. Doing so ends the covetous aura and the spell still affects the intended target.
[redacted PI]
Targeted object sprouts thousand of tiny iron spikes. These act as armor/shield spikes [enhanced at CL 5+], causing 1 point of piercing damage for each opponent's natural attack that hits.
[redacted PI]
Anoint a wounded creature with devil's blood or unholy water giving it fast healing 1. Does not repair silver or good damage. Target detects as evil for the duration.
Anoint a wounded creature with devil's blood or unholy water giving it fast healing 4. Does not repair silver or good damage. Target detects as an evil cleric for the duration.

Instantly transport you + (CASTERLEVEL/3) willing creature(s) [Medium-sized] to a specific or random destination on the target world. You do not need to have seen your destination, though you must have a solid grasp of to which world you wish to travel.

Inspire self or recent lover to vengeful rage against enemy who has wronged you. When in combat with that enemy, gain benefit of rage spell against them for (CASTERLEVEL) rounds [double if enemy is an ex-lover].
Create disk of sunlight on one arm that provides illumination as a torch. Melee attackers suffer 1d6 + (min(CASTERLEVEL,15)) points of fire damage on striking you.

Ward an area, redirecting all teleportation into or out of the area to a specific open space on a solid surface within the area on a failed Will save. The teleport attempt fails and this spell ends if the save is successful. A teleport trap can exclude a category of creatures.
Creature gains +4 morale bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects that rely on negative emotions or that would force him to harm an ally. Supresses such effects already in place.
Assume the form of any Small or Medium creature of the vermin type, gaining some abilities and a +2 resistance bonus to saves against mind-affecting spells.
Assume the form of any Tiny to Large creature of the vermin type, gaining many abilities and a +4 resistance bonus to saves against mind-affecting spells.

Send a hideous and unsettling vision to a specific sleeping creature that you name. This prevents restful sleep and causes 1d10 damage, leaving the subject fatigued and unable to regain arcane spells for 24 hours. In addition, a second spell of 6th level or lower [cast immediately afterwards] affects the creature on waking. This spell must affect one creature and cannot cause hit point damage.

Generate one dose of apparent clear, pure water that is foul secretion that functions as unholy water. In addition, affected creatures are sickened for 1d4 rounds and [on failed save] take 1d6 Intelligence and 1d6 Dexterity damage.

This spell summons your choice of one extraplanar advanced fiendish giant mantis, 1d3 fiendish giant mantises, or 1d4+1 giant mantises. They appear where you designate and act immediately, on your turn. You can mentally direct the actions of these summoned vermin as a free action. All mantises summoned by this spell-like ability are blood red, and gain no racial bonus on Stealth checks in forests. Creatures cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support them. If you use this spell to summon fiendish mantises, it is an evil spell.
This spell functions like dispel magic, except that it can end more than one spell on a target and it can be used to target multiple creatures.
Calls any demon or combination of demons whose total combined CR is 20 or lower. This ability always works, and is equivalent to a 9th-level spell.
This spell functions like teleport, except that there is no range limit and there is no chance you arrive off target.
The target reptile grows to twice its normal size and eight times its normal weight.
You change the form of up to (CASTERLEVEL) willing reptiles into an animal of your choice.
